## AutoFromRequestHeaders {#Sisk_Core_Entity_CrossOriginResourceSharingHeaders_AutoFromRequestHeaders}

When applied to the [AllowHeaders](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Entity.CrossOriginResourceSharingHeaders.AllowHeaders.md) property, the HTTP server automatically applies
the incoming request headers to the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header.
